event_properties.content: Can you summarise this week's feedback?

This week: **247 total reviews** across all platforms. 68% positive, 18% neutral, 14% negative. Highlights: customers love the new dessert menu. Pain points: parking, wait times on Friday evenings. Net Promoter Score estimate: **+34** (up from +29 last week).
How can I keep complaints low ?

🎉 **You're Already Winning**
You have zero complaints across all 109 reviews — that's exceptional. Your 4.9 rating and 98% positive feedback show customers are genuinely happy with food quality, service, and ambience.

🔒 **What's Working Right Now**
Guests consistently praise staff by name (Nishi, Swati, Kiran, Savitri) for being warm and attentive. The authentic South Indian taste and fresh preparation are hitting the mark every time.

✅ **Keep This Momentum**
Maintain your current training standards and ingredient quality checks. Monitor **Greater Noida** closely — it only has 1 review at 3.0 stars, so gather more feedback there to spot any early issues before they become patterns.
What makes Indirapuram and Sector 18 perform so well?

⭐ **Exceptional Ratings**
**Indirapuram** holds a perfect 5.0 rating · **Sector 18** follows closely at 4.9 with 78 reviews

💝 **Staff Connection Drives Success**
Guests consistently mention staff by name — Sabitri, Kiran, Priyanka at **Indirapuram**, and Nishi, Swati, Martha at **Sector 18**. Customers felt genuinely welcomed and cared for, not just served. Many described the experience as warm, attentive, and personal.

✅ **Winning Formula to Replicate**
Both outlets nail authentic taste paired with exceptional hospitality. Train staff at **Greater Noida** and **NOIDA 120** to engage guests by name and empower them to make personalized recommendations — this human touch is what turns first-time visitors into loyal fans.
What specific dishes are customers praising at these outlets?

🍽️ **Customer Favorites**
Guests are raving about **Benne Dosa**, **Masala Dosa**, **Rava Dosa**, and **Podhi Idli** across your outlets. The **Neer Dosa Meal** and **Malabar Paratha Meal** also earned special mentions for their variety and authenticity.

🌟 **What Makes Them Stand Out**
Many diners felt these dishes delivered exceptional taste and texture — some even described the dosa as the best they've ever had. The authentic South Indian flavors and fresh preparation consistently impressed customers.

✅ **Recommended Action**
Highlight these hero dishes on your menu and train staff to recommend them confidently. Consider featuring **Benne Dosa** and **Neer Dosa Meal** in promotional campaigns to attract new guests.
Which outlet has the highest praise for dosas?

**Sector 18** receives the most dosa praise across your outlets. Customers frequently highlighted the masala dosa, rava dosa, and benne dosa as standout items, with many calling it the best South Indian food they've had in Noida. One guest even described the dosa as so good they 'felt like crying' — that's the kind of emotional connection you want to replicate across all locations.

What does my recent negative reviews say about my brand?

🚨 **Brand Perception Alert**
Your recent negative reviews paint a concerning picture — nearly 1 in 3 customers left unhappy, and the feedback centers heavily on food quality and consistency. Words like "worst," "bland," and "not fresh" appeared repeatedly, signaling a disconnect between price expectations and what's being delivered.
